instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript / JSX files (.js / .jsx) as configured in the frontend codebase.
Do NOT create or wrap output in markdown codeblocks inside this file.
Ensure every interactive element (button, link, input, tab, accordion trigger) includes a clear 'data-testid' attribute.
Do NOT use fake countdown timers, fake live buyer notifications, fake testimonials, or income claims.
Render testimonials ONLY if genuine user reviews exist; otherwise keep the section hidden or replace with verified product features.
Use Lucide-React icons throughout for clean visual alignment.
Use Shadcn UI primitives (Accordion, Tabs, Dialog, DropdownMenu, RadioGroup) wrapped in custom Tailwind styling.
Ensure dark dark mode or high-contrast dark sections use solid deep colors (#090D16, #111827) rather than purple/violet gradients.
Always provide a sticky mobile bottom purchase bar for the landing page that smooth scrolls to the edition picker.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid attribute to all interactive and key informational elements (e.g. data-testid='cta-buy-digital-button')
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast_rule: Normal text must meet 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast against background. Never place dark text over dark surfaces.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing_rule: Containers with borders MUST have generous internal padding (p-6, p-8, p-12) to prevent text collision.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_purple_gradients: Strictly refrain from using purple (#7351B7) gradients or purple glow effects.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toast_notifications: Use 'sonner' toast library for action feedbacks (e.g. coupon applied, added to cart, copy link).
